fullSuite.disposition: Recorded as integration failures; this experiment did not modify release tests, archive metadata, ignore rules or the Git index. No rerun or weakened assertion was used to claim a green suite.

officialClientSmoke.result: All six reset scenes created real official-Appium-Client sessions, read package/context/source and an element, and deleted their owned session. focus-submit additionally used focus/click/clear/input/XPath Save and passed its independent saved-state oracle in four actions.
officialClientSmoke.scope: Before final observation-journal, selector and stale-handle corrections; final native matrix exercises the frozen corrected implementation
officialClientSmoke.initialInvocation: Without PYTHONPATH the script could not import tests.e2e; that invocation did not start a scene/session and is not reported as a pass

independentSourceReview.finalDisposition: No remaining blocking findings in the reviewed implementation
correctedBeforeAnyAgentTask: Reject partially understood UiSelector expressions rather than silently discarding predicates
Invalidate detached element handles permanently, including when a semantic key later reappears
Require actual full-population and end-marker observations under a valid matching filter state; guessed count/find handles alone cannot pass
Require real persisted target reload with exact contents, not save/editor consistency alone
Require actual opening and separately indexed phase observations, including repeated amounts
Treat all category/status filters as wildcards; six existing positive/boundary tests failed before this predicate fix and passed afterward
independentSourceReview.limitations: Read-only static review, not independent execution or empirical outcome approval

frozenRunRules: One independent Agent and Kernel per arm/case; same native client, model, Runtime wheel, goal, initial state, action budget and outer deadline
Twelve predeclared runs with balanced alternating arm order; no retries, post-result tuning or successful-result cherry picking
Only three captured textual pre-fix Skill documents differ in the old arm; current installed template and official dependencies otherwise match
Only documented synthetic WebDriver interface is exposed; state oracles remain test-side
Report business correctness and protocol/cleanup separately
No physical device, official benchmark reward, formal qualification or statistically significant benefit claim
